name: component-expansion-fluid-string-param-is-baked-into-property-call-names
source:
COMPONENT Probe(p)
  PARAM fluid$ = Water
  p.rho = Density(fluid$, T=p.T, P=p.P)
END
Probe A(a)
Probe B(b, fluid$=Air)

error.message: There are 2 equations and 6 variables. The problem is underspecified and cannot be solved. Free quantities (no defining relation): a.rho, a.t, b.rho, b.t. Coupled to: a.p, b.p. A common cause: an element chain with no constitutive law for that quantity — e.g. an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through between boundaries leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free; add an orifice/valve/flow-map element or pin a boundary value.
